tei:div.tei:p:
Then did Moses sing together with the Children of Israel this song to the Lord and those are the words: I will sing to the Lord for He is truly exalted, the steed and its rider has He flung into the sea. My strength and song is the Lord and He was my salvation, this is my God that I may glorify Him, my father’s God that I may exalt Him. The Lord is a warrior, His name is the Lord. Pharaoh’s chariot and army did He throw into the sea and the finest of his captains were sunk in the Sea of Reeds. The depths cover them, they went down to the bottom like a stone. Thy right hand, O Lord, is wonderful in strength, Thy right hand O Lord shatters the enemy. And in the abundance of Thy grandeur dost Thou destroy Thy foes, when Thou sendest forth Thine anger, it consumes them like stubble. And through the breath of Thy nostrils are the waters heaped up, flowing waters stand up like a mound, the depths congeal in the heart of the sea. The enemy thought, I will pursue,
I will overtake, I will distribute spoil, my appetite will be satisfied with it, I will unsheathe my sword that my hand may deprive them. Thou didst blow with Thy wind, the sea covered them, they sank like lead in the mighty waters. Who is like Thee among the powerful, O Lord, who is like Thee so wonderful in holiness, awe-inspiring in praise, worker of wonder. When Thou didst extend Thy right hand the earth swallowed them. By Thy grace hast Thou led this people Thou hast redeemed, Thou hast led in Thy strength to Thy holy dwelling. The peoples have heard, they quake, trembling has seized the inhabitants of Philistia. Then have the rulers of Edom been terrified, as for the notables of Moab, fright seizes them, all inhabitants of Canaan have melted with fear. Let awe and dread fall upon them, through the greatness of Thine arm let them be silent as the stone until Thy people pass, O Lord, until this people whom Thou hast acquired shall pass. Thou wilt bring them and plant them upon the mount of Thine inheritance, the site for Thy dwelling which Thou hast made, O Lord, the sanctuary, O Lord, which Thy hands have established. The Lord will reign for ever and ever. The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
